assets.name: New backdrop
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Menu Material website gallery, single square food photograph.
Input image: the attached original photograph is the EDIT TARGET, not inspiration.
Primary request: edit this exact strawberry-cheesecake photograph into a professionally lit restaurant menu photograph. Change only the surrounding environment, lighting, color balance and presentation cleanup.
Subject invariants: preserve the original tall wedge of pale ivory cheesecake with its thin golden crust, irregular cut face, glossy red strawberry sauce, exact strawberry count/shape/positions on top, and the single existing cut strawberry resting in front on the plate. Keep the dessert's exact portion, height, wedge silhouette, topping arrangement, food colors and natural edible textures. Preserve the original plain white round plate and dessert-to-plate arrangement. Preserve the same camera viewing angle and orientation, with wedge point facing left and wider back at right; do not rotate or redesign the food. Existing sauce belongs to the dish. Do not add mint, herbs, icing, berries, extra sauce, cutlery or any other food.
Composition/framing: 1:1 square, one image only. Pull the framing back while preserving viewpoint so the entire round white plate and entire dessert fit comfortably inside the central 85% of the square, with clear margin on every side. Dessert and plate centered. Keep everything recognizable as the identical uploaded dish. Remove distracting background plates, sugar packets, containers and restaurant clutter.
Style: realistic food photography with convincing light physics, natural surface detail, appetizing clarity, no artificial plastic texture.
Avoid: cropped plate or food, invented toppings or sides, changes to berry arrangement, altered cheesecake shape, new props, branding, lettering, watermark, collage, split panel.
Scene/backdrop: a saturated cobalt-blue seamless studio tabletop and background, no other objects. Lighting/mood: crisp clean commercial studio light with a defined believable soft-edged cast shadow, vivid blue environment and bright natural red strawberries, controlled highlights on the original glossy sauce.

assets.name: From above
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: square editorial food photography for a restaurant gallery, high resolution approximately 1254 × 1254 pixels.
Input image: the provided local photograph is the EDIT TARGET and source of truth for the food, not a loose inspiration.
Preserve invariants: the same identifiable tall triangular strawberry-cheesecake wedge, ivory filling with its subtle horizontal seam, thin golden crumb base, thick glossy red strawberry glaze, original strawberry topping count and relative arrangement, one loose strawberry on the same plain round white ceramic plate. View-dependent occlusion is natural, but do not add or remove strawberries. Preserve the natural irregular cut surfaces and dense creamy texture. No new ingredients, toppings, garnish, sauces, cutlery, text, logos, watermark, graphics, or collage. Natural, delicious, believable photographic fidelity. Remove the source's background clutter, extra plates, sugar packets and wood table. This is a deliberate change of physical camera position and scene, not merely a recolor or crop of the source.
Primary request: Rephotograph the same cheesecake and white plate from a genuine 90-degree straight-down overhead camera, as a beautiful food editorial flat lay. The full round white plate is centered on a rich matte charcoal surface, with generous dark margins all around. The cheesecake is visibly triangular from directly above, its point oriented toward the lower-left. See the same glossy red berries in their original relative placement from overhead. The tall side face of the filling must not dominate because the camera is truly straight down. Use soft directional daylight, refined shadows and realistic texture. Output one square image with only the plate and original cheesecake/loose berry on the charcoal surface.

assets.name: Served by hand
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: replacement square editorial food photograph for Menu Material's "Served by hand" gallery, approximately 1254 × 1254 pixels.
Input images: Image 1 (cheesecake-original.jpg) is the edit target and authoritative food identity source. Image 2 (cheesecake-served.webp) is only a supporting reference for appetizing photographic detail; do not preserve its person, torso, apron, setting or two-hand pose.
Primary request: Rather than an image of someone's body presenting the cheesecake, have it be a hand presenting the plate fancily.
Scene/backdrop: restrained, softly lit dark studio background.
Subject and invariants: faithfully preserve the exact identifiable strawberry cheesecake wedge from Image 1: same creamy filling, thin golden crust, large portion, red glaze, same five visible strawberry topping pieces in the same arrangement, including the front-facing cut strawberry, and the same single loose strawberry on the plate in front. Preserve the same plain round white plate. No ingredient changes, additions, garnish or props.
Composition/framing: square frame; full plate visible with tasteful small margins; three-quarter food view showing the cake face and glossy topping. One elegant natural hand enters from an edge, palm up, with fingers gracefully supporting the underside of the plate in a refined restaurant-service gesture. Show only this one hand, its wrist and a small portion of forearm. The plate and cheesecake remain the visual focus.
Style/medium and lighting: photorealistic premium editorial food photography; beautifully controlled soft light on creamy filling and glossy red strawberries; sharp appetizing detail with natural textures, physically realistic scale, anatomically plausible hand and believable contact and shadows under the supported plate.
Avoid: absolutely no torso, apron, face, shoulders, second hand, extra fingers, extra limbs, jewelry, text, logo, watermarks, table, cutlery, new toppings or decorative objects.
